rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for an era or broad historical time period.

example.english: People in that era lived very tough lives.
example.traditional: 嗰個時代嘅人生活得好辛苦。
example.jyutping: go2 go3 si4 doi6 ge3 jan4 sang1 wut6 dak1 hou2 san1 fu2

rows.note: Use this for an era viewed through its years or as a named historical period, such as the 1960s.

example.english: The 1980s era saw many new trends take off.
example.traditional: 八十年代興起咗好多新潮流。
example.jyutping: baat3 sap6 nin4 doi6 hing1 hei2 zo2 hou2 do1 san1 ciu4 lau4

rows.note: Use this specifically for a geological era in geology or earth-science contexts.

example.english: This geological era lasted for tens of millions of years.
example.traditional: 呢個地質年代延續咗幾千萬年。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 dei6 zat1 nin4 doi6 jin4 zuk6 zo2 gei2 cin1 maan6 nin4
